findings.description: Required m0-unit check exits 5: tests/unit collects zero tests. Add meaningful tests/unit/test_m0_*.py covering success and all failure behaviors; zero collection cannot count as pass.

ProcessRunner.communicate buffers complete output before enforcing max_output_bytes. External child writes 65536 bytes with budget 64 then sleeps: observed timed_out, truncated=false, empty returned output instead of promptly stopping on output_limit. Enforce combined budget during concurrent reads; preserve bounded output and terminate descendants.

Parser accepts incomplete output with unknown field and status=failed as completed, filling missing identity/schema fields. It also returns completed when actual ProcessResult exit_code=7 or truncated=true. Validate every schema field/type/unknown key and declared status, then independently gate success on actual exit 0 and no truncation. Do not discard valid model/summary/artifacts.

External probe accepts artifact path ".." as completed. Current substring checks also permit noncanonical dot/repeated-slash paths, omit artifact hash validation, and can raise TypeError for nonstring path. Reject malformed/noncanonical paths and validate the entire artifact/usage schema without reflecting untrusted raw values in errors.

Timeout/cancel branches unconditionally report tree_cleanup_confirmed=true even though _kill_process_group suppresses kill errors and wait timeout. No finally closes pipes/reaps process on every exceptional path. Establish actual cleanup evidence and release resources; never claim confirmation after a suppressed failure. Static review; protected POSIX descendant cases passed on this Linux run.

Popen unconditionally uses preexec_fn=os.setpgrp, including require_tree_cleanup=false, so Windows normal short processes fail rather than execute as the API requires. Use supported platform-specific launch paths; avoid preexec_fn for thread-safe POSIX startup. Windows runtime not available/tested.

Delivery report has task_id M0 rather than frozen M0-process-adapter, abbreviated baseline, snapshot N/A and code SHA pending commit. Bind corrected report to actual code commit, full baseline/bundle, checks/counts, and truthful unverified platform scope; required unit run missing.
